lists.name: RYM Top — Rock — Garage Rock Revival

podcast.body: This album was released in 2008 by Foxboro Hot Tubs, a confirmed side project of Green Day. It proved to be a success, turning into "something of an alternative radio hit" for a period. "There's been one album from the Hot Tops, a 2008 release entitled Stop, Drop, and Rule, and it turned into something of an alternative radio hit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
